items.source: The default implementation returns the method's name and the short name of the method's declaring class, separated by the "@" symbol.

items.source: This method is only invoked by style(Object) as a fallback, if none of the other style*() methods is suitable for the object's type.

items.source: The default implementation delegates to ClassUtils.getShortName(Class).

items.source: The default implementation delegates to String.valueOf(Object).

encapsulate styling algorithms for each type of styled object.
